characterizations.result_summary: Maximum absorption bands of the polymers were observed in the range 438-452 nm, trans-cis isomerization of azobenzene groups was detected under illumination.

evidence.source_sentence: UV-vis spectra were made using Diode Array Hewlett Packard Spectrophotometer 8452 and quartz cuvettes of 1 cm spectral path.

The UV-vis spectra were made for monomers and polymers in DMSO solutions. The maximum absorption band of both classes of materials was observed within wavelength in the range 440–460 nm (Tables 1 and 2).
